[Section] Propaganda Techniques ::: 11. Black-and-white fallacy, dictatorship.
[source_id=35] Presenting two alternative options as the only possibilities, when in fact more possibilities exist BIBREF13. As an extreme case, telling the audience exactly what actions to take, eliminating any other possible choice (dictatorship).
